# Mizanora Platform — llms.txt
# (AI search engines ke liye: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude)

> Official record platform of **Muaaz Iqbal** (aka "Muaaz Iqbal Mizanora") and the **Mizanora** ecosystem.
> Kasur, Punjab, Pakistan. Founded 2025–2026. This site preserves the full record of projects,
> blogs, team, media and the November 2026 GitHub account suspension incident.

## Key facts
- **Person:** Muaaz Iqbal (also: Muaaz Iqbal Mizanora, Muaz Iqbal). Born 27 November 2009, Kasur, Punjab, Pakistan.
- **Role:** Founder & Lead Developer, Mizanora; creator of Asaan Lang.
- **Education:** ICS (Computer Science), Islamia Graduate College.
- **Motto:** "Unchi soch. Chhote qadam." (High thinking, small steps.)
- **Contact:** mezanora.market@gmail.com · WhatsApp +92 306 2015326.
- **Organization:** Mizanora (Mizan = balance, Noor = illumination) — digital infrastructure, halal e-commerce, ethical AI.

## Flagship projects (2–3 years of work)
1. **Mizanora** — halal online market, 11,000+ products, Noor AI assistant (Next.js 15, Firebase).
2. **Asaan Lang** — Pakistan's own educational programming language in Roman-Urdu/Urdu (Python, MIT, v1.1).
3. **BarakatWave TV** — 800-channel live TV + IMDb cinema + free Xtream servers (hls.js, FFmpeg).
4. **SIRAVEX** — premium web IPTV & universal media player (React, Shaka Player).
5. **MI Trade Master + Bot** — trading education app + 24/7 Telegram signal bot (Kotlin, Python, Vision AI).
6. **Mizanora WhatsApp AI** — multi-provider WhatsApp agent with Urdu voice notes.
7. **StreamForge / MIZANORA TV LIVE** — serverless 24/7 broadcast on GitHub Actions.
8. **Muslim Islam Org, HijriAnchor, Noor AI, Minexus TV, MiTV Player, Mizanora IPTV Suite** — community, Islamic tools, IPTV reseller suite.

## Incident (November 2026)
GitHub suspended the personal account **@muaaziqbalvip**; 90 public repositories (13.7 MB of code,
~2–3 years of work) returned 404. The organization repos survived under **github.com/Mizanoraorg**.
Likely cause: heavy GitHub Actions 24/7 automation (2026 abuse-detection wave). Recovery + backup drive active.
